note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after eight searches for this part, and many county sites did not resolve (Pulaski, Breckinridge, Shelby, Gallatin) or refused the connection (Woodford), so most of the 30 candidates (magistrates, constables, county clerks, jailers, coroners, the Nelson PVA, two sheriffs, three school boards, Danville's commissioner race) were not found on any page that could be read and are left blank. The Kentucky Secretary of State's candidate pages did not resolve. For the two sitting legislators no campaign website was found; the Republican Party of Kentucky lists both without saying it endorses them (already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json), so nothing is recorded under endorsed_by. The Jefferson County Clerk's 2026 filing list (2026-candidate-filing-8-10-26.pdf) prints Louisville Metro Council races as 'Nonpartisan.', which agrees with our record. Glasgow's own mayor page and Louisville Metro's council pages answer 403 to scripts and WebFetch, so they are not used. Danville's City Commission page does not list James Chandler and the Glasgow Independent Schools board page names its members only through script, so nothing is recorded for them. While exploring, one e-mail cell of the Jefferson County filing PDF and street addresses on Radcliff's government page appeared in this agent's own output; none of it is stored here.
